attr.title: AnnoRead 阿诺阅读
attr.desc: LÖVE reader with Legado-style sources, built-in Chinese virtual keyboard and optional MiMo TTS. Original 720x720 layout. AArch64 and GLIBC >= 2.38 required. Device testing pending.
attr.inst: Requires PortMaster love_11.5 runtime and curl >= 7.75 with HTTPS support. Import your own book sources into annoread/sources/. See annoread/README.md for TTS setup.
